notes.title: Feature Showcase | Labors and Boons
notes.content:
Hey all,In this update I show you two features of Sunset Sprout that are essential addition to the gameplay loop and are special to the game, here's the run down:

Labors


Labors are Daily, Weekly, and 2Weeks long challenges where you have to plant a certain number of items to get rewarded with gems, it is one of the best ways to get gems in game!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564684/65ad422706e6a5aed8ecd3e1409a73e25e424136.png"]


Boons


Boons are a substantial upgrades to your farm, giving you the ability to get more out of your farming, crafting and selling! you gain them by completing main quests with Enid.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564684/bc861a0ba5453fbdbab6d3320b2895185bf876a0.gif"]


What are your thoughts? is there anything you would like to ask or add? lets have a conversation! Wishlist Sunset Sprout now!

notes.title: Feature Showcase | Building and crafting
notes.content:
Hello Farmers! 

Continuing where we left off last time, lets take a look at the crafting, building and repairing features in Sunset Sprout!


So, to craft something, you need to have a building built and repaired



and there are two main ways you can get crating building in game; these ways are:



Repairing broken crafting stations:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564684/1b5875d22135719105c26fae0e4f449393526a6b.gif"]

Building new crafting stations from the building menu:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564684/6e9950c901c999860d3340eb3d69f351850dca83.gif"]
and these are the two main ways you can craft items in Sunset Sprout, there is twenty building already in the game, with way more to come, stay toned!
